reviews.reason: The active node type supplies a fixed schema layout from buildCommonConfigBlocks. This fallback SchemaRenderer branch is not user-sortable/filterable data; field blocks that can be hidden keep path keys. No current producer reorders these structural schema slots within one node-type editor. NodeInspector consumes the fixed per-node-type config layout from node-schema-registry/buildCommonConfigBlocks. Editable field children are already keyed by childBlock.path; the index fallbacks are structural/view blocks in the fixed schema, not an editable/reordered record list. The current registry constructs the order from the builtin contract and has no interactive insertion/reordering of these blocks. Reassessed 2026-10-29: The delta adds explicit auto_compact configuration, nested config read/write and sibling-preserving editor updates. The current LLM tests assert opt-in defaults, roundtrips and unchanged history settings; existing field-render/helper and graph-selection counterexamples are unaffected.
